# DGBPLabZ

> DGBPLabZ is a project-based learning platform, operated by DevGameBlogPromo, teaching Web Development, AI & Machine Learning, and Cloud/DevOps through real projects and live mentorship. Based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India, with students across India and internationally.

DGBPLabZ was founded in 2023 by Kakarla Manish Reddy. Courses are project-first (not lecture-based), taught via live Discord sessions, and priced one-time in INR: Frontend Web Development (₹499), AI & Machine Learning (₹799), and Cloud Architecture & DevOps (₹999). Each course includes mentorship, project reviews, and a completion certificate.
